title: Medicaid: retained county enrollment snapshot
description: HPIO statistical redistribution of ODM enrollment and Census population, with explicit source dates.
dataPeriod: Retrieved February 19, 2025; enrollment month not specified
methodology: The source attributes enrollment to ODM Demographic and Expenditure Dashboard and total population to ACS 2023 five-year. Its February 2025 publication does not identify an enrollment month; published percentages remain unchanged.

source.title: Ohio Medicaid Basics 2025: county enrollment
source.publisher: Health Policy Institute of Ohio; original data ODM and U.S. Census Bureau
source.locator: Three-page county table and page 3 source note
source.note: Attribution identifies this as HPIO analysis, not a new raw ODM response.
source.rights: Attributed statistical facts; original publisher rights remain with its source.

rows.note: The source reports retrieval date, not a named enrollment month. Monthly ODM data can change for retroactive eligibility. The printed county spelling is retained alongside canonical geography.
